name: petrifying gaze
desc:
If a creature starts its turn within 30 ft. of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and the two of them can see each other, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can force the creature to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} isn't incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.
A creature that isn't surprised can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can't see the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If it looks at the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} in the meantime, it must immediately make the save. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sees its reflection within 30 ft. of it in bright light, it mistakes itself for a rival and targets itself with its gaze.
